title: People, process, and technology need a coordinated modernization plan.
modernization_pillar_2: Align adoption, process design, and platform choices to the outcomes and constraints teams confirm.
modernization_pillar_4: Simplify and govern work before changing its supporting systems.
modernization_pillar_5: • Map handoffs and redesign workflows around measurable outcomes.
modernization_pillar_7: Workflow options grounded in operating evidence.
modernization_pillar_9: Include employees and leaders so new practices can be adopted and sustained.
modernization_pillar_10: • Assess readiness, role impacts, skills, and ownership early.
modernization_pillar_12: Readiness and learning built into delivery.
modernization_pillar_14: Set a secure, resilient architecture and release approach.
modernization_pillar_15: • Select a transition path and build for maintainability.
modernization_pillar_17: Technology decisions tied to operating needs.
